items.summary: Present of -ir verbs like ouvrir: choose forms, gap-fill, underline -er-like verbs.
Present of -ir verbs like partir: matching subjects and completing with the right stem.
Partir-type verbs: pronouns, pluralising, choosing partir/venir/sortir, conjugating.
Opposites with -ir verbs, quitter/partir/sortir gap-fill; venir and tenir rule box.
Venir and its derivatives: matching, choosing forms, singular, être/venir with origins.
Venir/tenir derivatives, vous-to-tu, and the passé immédiat with venir de.
End of venir de drill and Bilan 4: two present-tense paragraph gap-fills.
Present of -dre verbs like attendre: matching, d/ds endings, écouter or entendre.
Attendre-type verbs: écouter/entendre, tu-to-vous, pluralising and conjugating.
Present of prendre-type verbs: choose the correct form and pluralise sentences.
Prendre-type stems and two-verb sentence gap-fills with -dre verbs.
Prendre-type sentence endings; -aindre/-eindre/-oindre verbs: s or t, pluralising.
Connaître and mettre type verbs: matching sentence halves and supplying pronouns.
Pluralising mettre/connaître verbs; vivre, croire, boire rule box and s or t.
Pluralise -re verbs, lire/écrire rule box, matching subjects, put into singular.
